name: printables
description: Printables (printables.com) is Prusa's 3D-model sharing site. This CLI is meant to search and fetch 3D printable models, but no usable endpoints were captured because Cloudflare blocked the explorer.
notes: Exploration was blocked by Cloudflare's 'Performing security verification' challenge. The homepage request (E1) returned only a 307 redirect into the challenge, and /search/models?q=phone stand never loaded, so no data endpoints were recorded.
No commands were generated. A specification based on the single recorded request would only replay the Cloudflare redirect, and inventing endpoints that were not observed would not pass verification.

The Printables web app is believed to load its data from a GraphQL API (likely https://api.printables.com/graphql/), but that was not observed in this recording. Re-run exploration with a browser profile that passes Cloudflare (headed mode, real user agent, or a valid cf_clearance cookie) to capture the search, model detail, user profile, collection and comment operations, then regenerate the specification.
